evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Unhedged plain declarative with no commitment markers or delivery evidence; asserted and defensible but not performed as settled or ratified, so claim rather than decision.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Unhedged plain assertion of a contrast; no permanence language or ratification, so held at claim rather than principle or decision.
